rules.match: skill_dir does NOT exist AND payload does NOT have embedded bash one-liner
same cron name appears 2+ in jobs.json AND schedules identical AND scripts identical

skill in dormant_rails list (= retreat / tomb / fashion-LP-not-live / coconala-not-listed / trustmrr-no-MRR-gt-500) AND >30 day no real revenue event
rules.reason: rail 未本番、 product family 一括 で Dais 判断

naist_learning: naist-pull (= hourly skill 版 のみ、 inline */15 は 削除 済)
mail_lateness_physical: anicca-morning-report (= lateness Slack alert NOT digest)

before_disable_checklist: 1. verify skill SKILL.md description does NOT contain ANY of: 'post to TikTok' / 'post to IG' / 'post to YouTube' / 'publish to substack' / 'publish to zenn' / 'publish to dev.to' / 'publish to note' / 'publish to blog' / 'send email' / 'cold mail' / 'apply' / 'cafe' / 'naist' / 'self-heal' / 'heartbeat'
2. verify cron is NOT in any guardrails_NEVER_DISABLE list
3. verify cron's recent runs (= last 7 days) — if 1+ successful real action, NOT disable
4. verify launchd does NOT host same daemon (= R6)
5. emit disable candidate to workspace/tasks.json (= pending status) BEFORE actual disable
6. after 24h Slack observation, if no engine death signal, actual disable
operational_path: cron-auto-disable (daily 03:11 JST) → load this audit-rules.json → read harvester events (~/.openclaw/state/events/*.jsonl) → filter by rules → cross-check guardrails → emit candidates → openclaw cron disable <id> → Slack '🧹 cron-auto-disable: X→Y (R1:.., R2:..)' #content-metrics
